environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) behind an Application Load Balancer with no rule groups attached. Security group allows inbound TCP 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The ALB forwards to target group on port 8080. No additional middleware or proxy filtering is configured. The application runs as a systemd service under the 'appuser' account with read/write access to /var/app/data/.

config.network: VPC with public subnet, ALB security group allows 0.0.0.0/0:443
